title: Queried random batch run distribution
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and a natural number $m$, the program’s run law is that of drawing a uniformly random sequence $(x_i)_{i=1}^m$ from $\{−1,1\}^n$ and returning the labeled sequence $(x_i,f(x_i))_{i=1}^m$. Every outcome has cost $(0,m,mn+m)$: no random examples, $m$ membership queries, and $mn+m$ units of work.
